stem: Meera buys a cell for her torch at a shop in Jaipur. In this cell, the electrolyte is in the form of a moist paste rather than a free liquid, so the cell can be carried and used easily in everyday devices. Which type of cell is this?

options.text: a Voltaic cell, because it always contains a liquid electrolyte
a dry cell, because its electrolyte is a paste and it is convenient for daily use
a solar cell, because it uses sunlight to produce current
a dynamo, because it produces electricity by rotation

teacher.key_rationale: A cell whose electrolyte is held as a moist paste (not a free liquid) is classified as a dry cell; this makes it portable and convenient for everyday devices such as torches. A Voltaic cell uses a liquid electrolyte and is less convenient. Therefore the key is B.
